bio:
K'ARAX

*Monthly*

Precolumbian is a Peruvian DJ, producer, and cultural creator based in Philadelphia, recognized for her hyper-percussionist style that blends diverse genres and has helped shape the contemporary sound of Latin club music. creepitona is an Ecuadorian DJ, audiovisual artist, and researcher born in Lenapehoking (Brooklyn), whose practice draws from Andean methodologies and explores electronic reinterpretations of the region's historical sounds. For years, Precolumbian and Creepitona have collaborated on parties and performances across New York City, Philadelphia and South America, centering contemporary electronic music from Latin America and its diasporas. Together they've recently launched their new party series, K'ARAX,  As a radio show, K'ARAX would build on this work by highlighting new club, ambient, and experimental sounds from the global majority, with a particular focus on artists from Latin America and its diasporas.
title: K'ARAX
